invocation_note: Used reduced xdist workers (-n 2) from the start, following the pattern from the prior sub-task's evidence (EPMCDME-14465), which found -n 8 overloaded the local Docker stack. Local stack was limited to elasticsearch, postgres, and the codemie backend container (docker compose up -d elasticsearch postgres codemie) rather than the full compose file, since the other services (langfuse, litellm, clickhouse, minio, kibana, nats, ui) are not needed for the sanity-api suite.
suite: sanity-api — API sanity suite, stable API tests without external service credentials
environment_notes: First attempt at bringing up the codemie backend container hung indefinitely in a disk-sleep (D) state during startup, never becoming reachable — likely Docker Desktop's Windows bind-mount I/O being extremely slow with uvicorn --reload watching the whole mounted repo tree. User deleted all containers and a fresh docker compose up succeeded cleanly.
verdict: PASS — no regressions introduced by EPMCDME-14467 changes
